title: rDXE · Edge language-model accelerator
tagline: Efficient language-model decoding at the edge.
description: A small-language-model decoder accelerator with scalable ring-based configuration for token-level pipelining. The paper reports measured energy efficiency of 5.26 TOPS/W.

publications.title: An 11.16 μJ/token Edge SLM Decoder Accelerator with Scalable Ring-based Configuration for Token-level Pipelining in 16nm FinFET
